name: gro-compiler
description: Per-turn (live) GRO material compiler. At the end of every agent turn, keeps a project's GRO artifact compiled: an ARA extended with the GRO material layer (temporal, refs, quantities, entities, claims_typed, genre, author-stated contributions). Pure material compilation — it structures what is present in the research; it makes no judgments and builds no metrics (no novelty typing, comparison to prior work, or significance scoring — that is a separate concern). The GRO analog of the ARA research-manager.
